dedupePolicy: Only hero, location-page, and gallery review decisions are eligible for selection.
Filename crop/edit variants are collapsed before public page assignment.
Winner priority: Hero > Location > Gallery, then largest refreshed pixel area, then larger file size.
Excluded variants are retained in this manifest for audit but should not be used on public pages.
